title: Massachusetts cranberry farm restored to wetland; thousands of fish return
content: A former cranberry farm in Plymouth, Massachusetts, has been transformed into a thriving freshwater wetland after restoration work began in 2010. Thousands of migratory fish, including alewife and blueback herring, returned to areas they had been unable to reach for more than 100 years.
